author: Ari Koslow
title: Bryan Reynolds goes deep Friday
desc: Bryan Reynolds went 2-for-5 with a home run in the Pirates 9-5 loss on Friday against the Nationals.
impact: Reynolds went yard off Foster Griffin in the third inning for his 12th homer of the season.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Mitch Keller takes loss Friday
desc: Mitch Keller allowed five runs on eight hits over six innings with one strikeout in a loss on Friday against the Nationals.
impact: Keller allowed runs in the first three innings, including three home runs. He settled in the rest of his outing, but it wasn't enough in the loss. He'll face the Braves next.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Ildemaro Vargas collects three hits Friday
desc: Ildemaro Vargas went 3-for-5 in the Diamondbacks 7-4 loss on Friday against the Brewers.
impact: Vargas drove in one run on an RBI single in the 11th inning. It wasn't enough after Milwaukee plated four runs in the top half of the inning.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Jose Cabrera pitches into fourth inning Friday
desc: Jose Cabrera allowed three runs on six hits over 3 1/3 innings with three strikeouts and three walks in a no-decision on Friday against the Brewers.
impact: Cabrera surrendered three runs in the second and third innings after a scoreless opening frame. He has yet to throw more than 80 pitches across his first three starts.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Jackson Merrill hits home run Friday
desc: Jackson Merrill went 1-for-4 with a home run in the Padres 4-3 loss against the Dodgers on Friday.
impact: Merrill extended the Padres lead to 2-0 with a solo blast in the fourth inning off Shohei Ohtani. It was second straight game with a long ball and 10th on the season.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Michael King records quality start Friday
desc: Michael King allowed two runs on three hits over six innings with five strikeouts and two walks in a no-decision on Friday against the Dodgers.
impact: King was dealing through six scoreless frames. He allowed a walk and single to begin the bottom of the seventh inning. Not only did those two runners scored, but Teoscar Hernandez hit a grand slam to turn the game upside down for a 4-3 Dodgers lead in another brutal loss for the Padres. King is scheduled to face the Diamondbacks next.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Luis Castillo records quality start in loss Friday
desc: Luis Castillo allowed two runs on five hits over six innings with four strikeouts and a walk in a loss on Friday against the Blue Jays.
impact: Castillo posted his second straight quality start. He pitched well enough to earn a win, but the Mariners lineup was shut out. Castillo is scheduled to face the Marlins next.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Jason Adam (shoulder) without timetable to return
desc: Jason Adam does not have a timetable to return.
impact: "I'd love to be back in games early to mid August...that's probably an aggressive goal, but that's my goal, he said." Adam was placed on the IL with a shoulder strain.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Janson Junk has rehab start pushed to Saturday
desc: Janson Junk will now make his next rehab start on Saturday.
impact: Junk was originally scheduled to start on Friday before the game was postponed.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Jarred Kelenic signs minor league deal with Rangers
desc: The Rangers signed Jarred Kelenic to a minor league contract.
impact: Kelenic returns to the Rangers organization after exploring free agency.

author: Ari Koslow
title: James McCann (quad) to play in rehab games Saturday, Sunday
desc: Diamondbacks manager Torey Lovullo told reporters that James McCann will play in rehab games on Saturday and Sunday.
impact: McCann began a rehab assignment on Thursday. He will be re-evaluated after Sunday's game.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Logan O'Hoppe exits early Friday
desc: Logan O'Hoppe left Friday's game early as a precaution.
impact: O'Hoppe was being evaluated for a concussion. There should be an update on his status on Saturday.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Shohei Ohtani (bicep) will not be in lineup Saturday
desc: Dodgers manager Dave Roberts told reporters that Shohei Ohtani will not be in Saturday's lineup.
impact: Ohtani left Friday's game early as a precaution. He is day-to-day.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Brendan Beck to be called up to start Saturday
desc: Yankees' manager Aaron Boone told reporters that Brendan Beck will be recalled from Triple-A Scranton/Wilkes-Barre to start on Saturday against the Twins.
impact: Beck has posted a 3.07 ERA over 88 innings in 16 starts at Triple-A Scranton/Wilkes-Barre this season. He will take the rotation spot of Carlos Rodon.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Spencer Jones optioned to Triple-A
desc: The Yankees optioned OF Spencer Jones to Triple-A Scranton/Wilkes-Barre.
impact: Jones will return to Triple-A to make room for starter Brendan Beck.
